scope: Minimal fail-closed source/publication policy enforcement in the one existing lab workflow. No source acquisition, recording, model change, scheduler replacement, dispatch, website write or activation.
contract: Run a stdlib metadata-only preflight immediately after checkout. Until a separately reviewed hosted handover replaces this fixed block, emit a bounded explicit BLOCKED readiness receipt and exit78 before install, restore, acquisition, prediction, grading, replay or persistence. No configuration flag, repository permission or manifest existence automatically unblocks it. Keep original cron/cadence/single-writer concurrency. Always upload only the exact readiness receipt while detailed health uploads require successful readiness.
public_payload: Only fixed-schema coarse readiness metadata is emitted by this guard. No source/state/model/player/game/forecast/outcome values or credentials. Existing reviewed branch publication remains exact-manifest gated; absence of private access must never select the legacy recursive public publisher.
private_owner_decision: Unresolved: approve genuinely private same-lab durable storage, with actual repository/artifact access verified and existing credentials/free allowance only. Making this lab repository private is a concrete owner-controlled option requiring no new key; public-repository Actions artifacts are not assumed private. A private branch in a public repo is not private. No visibility/access setting is changed here.
remaining: Separately freeze permitted source/runtime and horizon/qualified-consumer contracts, approved private durability plus exact public aggregate fallback, then finite real hosted acceptance/restore/idempotency/on-time delivery before verified handover. Scientific qualification and website activation remain separate.
